module purpose: neorv32_cpu_decompressor is a combinational unit that reads a 16-bit compressed instruction on instr_i, expands it by its opcode and funct3 fields (case statements at lines 65, 68, 106, 170 and 211) into a 32-bit instruction word held in decoded, flags encodings it rejects in illegal, and drives the word on instr_o with bit 1 forced to '0' when illegal is '1' (lines 299-301).

use-case flows.value: 16-bit compressed encoding from instr_i expanded into a 32-bit instruction word (opcode, register, funct and immediate fields) in decoded and driven on instr_o
illegal-encoding decision: illegal driven to '1' for encodings the predicates reject, reported by forcing instr_o(1) to '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Decompressed instruction word -- the 32-bit instruction this unit produces from a 16-bit compressed encoding (opcode, register, funct and immediate fields)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The operate flow reads the 16-bit encoding on instr_i, selects an arm by its opcode and funct3 fields (case selectors at lines 65, 68, 106, 170 and 211, each a SELECTS decoded record of instr_i) and assembles the 32-bit word in decoded, for example `decoded(instr_rd_msb_c downto instr_rd_lsb_c) <= "01" & instr_i(ci_rd_3_msb_c downto ci_rd_3_lsb_c);` (line 74), with immediates rearranged through the process variables imm20_v and imm12_v (lines 57-58, used at lines 116, 128-129). The word leaves through `instr_o(31 downto 2) <= decoded(31 downto 2);` (line 299), line 300 for bit 1, and `instr_o(0) <= decoded(0);` (line 301). Its consumer is not in this file, so Integrity is Established from lines 299-301: the consumer must receive exactly the word the selected arm defines for the given instr_i. Availability is also Established under RTL-visible conditions: the process has no clock or enable and is sensitive only to instr_i (line 52), and the default `decoded <= x"00000003";` (line 62) plus the others arms (lines 98, 165, 187, 199, 210, 289) give every input value a defined word. Confidentiality is not established: no line restricts who observes instr_o. Roles: instr_i sets, because this entity reads it both as field data and as case selector (occurrence 18, SOURCES decoded, line 74); decoded computes the word (occurrence 5, DERIVES_FROM instr_i, line 74; storage none, so it is combinational, not stored); instr_o is the exit port (occurrence 2, DERIVES_FROM decoded, line 299). Overwrite check: in the arm guarded by line 141, line 146 overrides line 144 under process semantics; under that guard both give the rd field "00010", so the result is unchanged. imm20_v and imm12_v are process variables, not candidates. The map and the RTL agree on these statements.

conceptual assets.concept: Illegal-encoding decision -- whether the 16-bit input is an encoding this unit rejects, and its report on the output word
conceptual assets.reasoning: The report flow computes one decision: illegal defaults to '0' (line 61) and is driven to '1' only under predicates on instr_i, such as `if (instr_i(12 downto 5) = "00000000") then` (lines 77-78), the unsupported funct3 arms (lines 98-100, 289-291) and the conditions at lines 153-154, 180-181, 203-204, 221-222, 232-234, 245-246, 256-258 and 266-267. The decision leaves the entity through `instr_o(1) <= decoded(1) when (illegal = '0') else '0';` (line 300). Its consumer is outside this file, so Integrity is Established from line 300: a wrong decision would either pass bit 1 of decoded through for an encoding the predicates reject, or force bit 1 to '0' for an encoding they accept. Availability follows the same combinational production as the word (line 52, default at line 61); confidentiality is not established. Roles: instr_i sets the decision (occurrence 23, GATES illegal, line 77); illegal computes it as an error flag (occurrence 3, GATED_BY instr_i, line 78); instr_o is the exit port (occurrence 3, GATED_BY illegal, line 300). The flow graph lists illegal as a constant-valued CONTROL-ONLY source because every driver is a literal (constant_drivers at lines 61-291); which literal holds is decided by the instr_i conditions, so it is a computed decision, not a fixed setting. illegal has no other use than gating instr_o(1) (occurrence 14).
